name: ysu-ir-dashboard
description: 연성대학교 IR 대시보드. Node와 로컬 PostgreSQL로 실행합니다.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
